case.pattern_description: Shared-device fraud ring: one device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) behind an anonymising proxy is used to make small online purchases on 28 unrelated customers' cards in the same weeks, each time appearing as a New device for that account. It affects many customers at once rather than one compromised card; the agent found it by traversing card -> transaction -> device -> card in TigerGraph and matching the profile to earlier confirmed undocumented cases.

sar.narrative: Customer C04274, holder of card C04274-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-18 19:12 and 2016-11-28 15:34, 3 transaction(s) totalling $484.76 were made on the card online from device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' through an anonymous proxy: $144.21 (3468463, 2016-11-18 19:12), $221.02 (3476202, 2016-11-21 17:34), $119.53 (3494535, 2016-11-28 15:34). The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards in the same period (C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C05448-K2, C06031-K2...), most of them behind anonymous proxies and each time as a new device, indicating a common actor. When contacted, the cardholder stated they did not make the transactions and still holds the card. The activity is suspicious because: Device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window around the alert; 28 of them behind an anonymous/hidden proxy and 28 flagged as a New device. 4 closed case(s) on cards that used this profile were confirmed fraud, 4 of them recorded as an undocumented pattern. It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-2985, CC-2649, CC-0849. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placed linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
